// PROBE FIXTURE for tests/unit/empty-extraction-never-active.test.ts.
// Everything in here is LEGITIMATE and the guard must flag NONE of it: the
// extraction is asked whether it carries a policy through the one predicate
// before anything becomes `active`, and `status: "active"` on a model that
// is not Policy (a relationship) is not an extraction write at all.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { getAIService } from "@/lib/services/ai"
import { extractionEmptyProcessingError, isEmptyExtraction } from "@/lib/wallet/unread-policy"

export async function probeChecked(policyId: string, document: unknown, stored: { insurerName: string; policyNumber: string }) {
    const extraction = await getAIService().extractPolicyData(document as any, { policyId })
    const insurerName = extraction.insurerName || stored.insurerName
    const policyNumber = extraction.policyNumber || stored.policyNumber
    if (isEmptyExtraction({ insurerName, policyNumber, extraction })) {
        await db.policy.update({
            where: { id: policyId },
            data: { status: "action_needed", acordData: { processingError: extractionEmptyProcessingError() } },
        })
        return
    }
    await db.policy.update({
        where: { id: policyId },
        data: { insurerName, policyNumber, status: "active" },
    })
}

export async function probeRelationship(relationshipId: string) {
    // A relationship lifecycle state — correct, and nothing to do with extraction.
    await db.customerRelationship.update({ where: { id: relationshipId }, data: { status: "active" } })
}
